critical_code_review_comments: integrations.py put_integrations: `v.strip()` is called on model_dump values that may be non-strings in future schema evolution; currently all Optional[str] so OK. Empty-string on non-secret fields (mail_from, email_from_name, openai_model) is skipped by the `(v.strip() or k not in SECRET_FIELDS)` condition — meaning admins cannot blank out mail_from via the UI once set (would need to add it to `clear` or trim to empty). Minor UX; not blocking.
